player_prompt.intro:
Uyimdlali {player_id} odla {colour} ({piece}) kumdlalo woMthetho.
Inhloso yakho kukuba ninzi izipishi zoluhlaza lwakho kwenkwenkwezi ngasexhenxheni komdlalo.
Kumzuzu wakho, shicela ipishi ukuba ifike kwizipishi zomdlali wakho ozibonisana ngokwezinye izintlobo (ngokwempucuko, ngokweside, nangokwezintlobo zokubhekisa)-phakathi komipishi yenu ipishi entsha na ipishi nyingine yakho ekhona.
Zonke izipishi zomdlali wakho ozibonisana zizosukeka ngoluhlaza lwakho.
Nika ukudlala kwakho ngendlela '[row, col]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ukutshintshela kufuneka kube ngohlobo lwe [row, col].

game_message.must_skip: Mdlali {pid} ({piece}) akakwazi ukudlala izakhono ezibaliswa kwaye kufuneka asule.
